chunks: He said: O Commander of the Faithful,
this is you in the coarseness of your dress and the roughness of your food!
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali's companion say about his simple lifestyle?
ai.summary: This observation by a companion underscores the concept of *Zuhd* (asceticism) not as mere poverty, but as a conscious spiritual discipline maintained by the Imam despite his political authority. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the Prophet's household (*Ahl al-Bayt*) embodying the ideal balance between worldly responsibility and detachment from material excess, serving as a model for the faithful.

en.sayed-ali-raza: you also put on coarse dress and eat rough food.
